# Board Gaming Hub

> A free browser-based collection of original and classic board games and simulations. Single-file HTML5, no installs, no accounts, no ads-on-gameplay. Originals span strategy, simulation, and puzzle; classics include the standard public-domain board game canon.

Every game on Board Gaming Hub is a single HTML file with no server-side dependency — open the page and play. The collection mixes original designs (Bisque, Tidelands, Aresia, Apoapsis, Floodline, Doctrine, Cliffwalkers, Tower / SKYSTACK, Bonneville Spillway Operator) with traditional games (Chess, Go, Backgammon, Mancala, Senet, Ur, Othello, Mahjong, Sudoku, Solitaire, Minesweeper, 2048). The engineering and science simulations each document the real formulas behind them — shallow-water flood routing, dam total-dissolved-gas curves, arcsecond-accurate eclipse ephemeris, and Tsiolkovsky/vis-viva orbital mechanics — in a "How the model works" section on the page. Several titles have companion native ports on itch.io and the Google Play Store.

## Core pages
- [Home / catalog](https://boardgaminghub.com/): All 32 games with editorial intro, category essays, and guide links
- [Play / ad-supported catalog](https://boardgaminghub.com/play): Primary discovery page with daily puzzles strip (Wordform, Drift, Sudoku)
- [Guides](https://boardgaminghub.com/guides/): 13 strategy/science articles — Wordform, Drift, Sudoku, solar eclipses, Floodline scenarios, Bonneville dam, chess, Klondike solitaire, 2048, Minesweeper, backgammon, Go/baduk, and Mahjong solitaire
- [Apps / native ports](https://boardgaminghub.com/apps): Links to itch.io and Play Store builds
- [About](https://boardgaminghub.com/about): Gaming hub mission and author background
- [Privacy](https://boardgaminghub.com/privacy)

## Original strategy games
- [Bisque](https://boardgaminghub.com/bisque): Risk-style naval area control over 26 territories — deploy, attack, and fortify; last captain standing wins
- [Tidelands](https://boardgaminghub.com/tidelands): Coastal resource management
- [Aresia](https://boardgaminghub.com/aresia): Mars-colonization strategy
- [Doctrine](https://boardgaminghub.com/doctrine): 1990–2050 geopolitical sim, Aerobiz-style, real d3-geo world map
- [Agora](https://boardgaminghub.com/agora): Mediterranean trade — roll for resources, trade at the central Agora, race to 30 coins
- [Convergence](https://boardgaminghub.com/convergence): Catan-style economy with a swinging market — build settlements, cities, roads, and markets to 12 VP
- [Drift](https://boardgaminghub.com/drift): Daily word-ladder puzzle — change one letter per step
- [Odyssey](https://boardgaminghub.com/odyssey): Poseidon's tide floods islands on a cycle — harvest, build camps/temples/triremes, race to 15 VP
- [Pente Grammai](https://boardgaminghub.com/pentegrammai): Ancient Greek racing game
- [Wordform](https://boardgaminghub.com/wordform): Word puzzle

## Original simulations
- [Apoapsis](https://boardgaminghub.com/apoapsis): 3D rocket-trajectory sim built on Three.js
- [Tower / SKYSTACK](https://boardgaminghub.com/tower): High-rise property-management sim with named tenants and choice events
- [Floodline](https://boardgaminghub.com/floodline): Real California water-physics flood-defense game across six historical scenarios
- [Bonneville Spillway Operator](https://boardgaminghub.com/bonnevillespillwayoperator): Dam-operations sim with grid, wind, salmon, total dissolved gas, and lockages
- [Cliffwalkers](https://boardgaminghub.com/cliffwalkers): Lemmings-style puzzle
- [Biosphere Blue](https://boardgaminghub.com/biosphereblue): Planet-ecology sim (renamed from SimEarth)
- [Metropolis 2K](https://boardgaminghub.com/metropolis2k): City-building sim
- [Eclipse Predictor](https://boardgaminghub.com/eclipsepredictor): Astronomical eclipse prediction tool

## Classic board games
- [Chess](https://boardgaminghub.com/chess), [Go](https://boardgaminghub.com/go), [Backgammon](https://boardgaminghub.com/backgammon), [Othello](https://boardgaminghub.com/othello)
- [Mancala](https://boardgaminghub.com/mancala), [Senet](https://boardgaminghub.com/senet), [Ur](https://boardgaminghub.com/ur), [Mahjong](https://boardgaminghub.com/mahjong)

## Puzzles and solo games
- [Sudoku](https://boardgaminghub.com/sudoku), [Solitaire](https://boardgaminghub.com/solitaire), [Minesweeper](https://boardgaminghub.com/minesweeper), [2048](https://boardgaminghub.com/2048)
- [Abacus](https://boardgaminghub.com/abacus): Playable soroban with calculator pad, Arabic and Roman display

## Audience
Casual web players looking for free no-install games, board-game hobbyists exploring original designs, students using simulations for learning, and tabletop fans wanting digital takes on ancient and classic games.

## Pricing
Free. No accounts, no subscriptions, no in-game purchases. Site supported by passive ads on listing pages only — never on gameplay pages. Several games have paid native ports on itch.io and the Google Play Store; the web versions remain free.
